name: Pi 1.0 Coding Agent Setup: Installation and MCP Guide
description: Install Pi with npm install -g --ignore-scripts @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent (Node.js 22.19 or newer) or the pi.dev installer script. Verify the install with pi --version, then start pi in a project folder. Log in to a model provider with /login. Add an MCP server with pi mcp add and check it with pi mcp list. Reload with /reload and let the model call the server from a codemode script.
